projects.title: Bridge to the Moon
projects.description: First-person 3D comic-style game in Godot 4. Tear car wrecks apart in a scrapyard, press steel into girders and walk them out to the end of a bridge that grows all the way to the Moon. Robots, outposts, traders, asteroid showers and a signal from the Moon. Alone or co-op.
projects.tagline: 384,400 km. One girder at a time.

projects.title: Project Lazy
projects.description: A cozy 2D farming game for Godot 4. Six crops, timing mini-games for hoeing and watering, a day-night cycle with weather, orders, customers and your own market stall where you set the prices.
projects.tagline: Water the field. Watch it grow. Nap.

projects.title: ReadTrack
projects.description: Offline-first Flutter app to track books, fanfiction, web novels and manga. Paste a link and title, author, cover and chapters are filled in. Read online inside the app or download chapter ranges as EPUB, FB2, HTML or TXT.
projects.tagline: Every story you read, in one shelf.
